facts.claim: In the Ganapati Khand of the Brahmavaivarta Purana, Tulsi, performing austerities on the Ganga bank, asks Ganesh to marry her and he politely declines
facts.source: Brahmavaivarta Purana, Ganapati Khand, adhyay 46 (numbering differs by edition)

facts.claim: The text has Tulsi and Ganesh exchange curses, after which both accept their destinies (Tulsi as wife of Narayana)
facts.source: Brahmavaivarta Purana, Ganapati Khand, adhyay 46 (numbering differs by edition)

facts.claim: The episode ends with the rule that tulsi leaves are not offered in Ganesh puja; the story is also told, with variations, in other Puranas
facts.source: Brahmavaivarta Purana, Ganapati Khand, adhyay 46; puja parampara
